inlines.v: STUPEFACTION, noun [Latin See Stop.] 1. The act of rendering stupid. 2. A stupid or senseless state; insensibility; dullness; torpor; stupidity. Resistance of the dictates of conscience brings a hardness and stupefaction upon it.
